title: ICSBEP Validation Report
description: Statistical validation analysis of ICSBEP benchmark k_eff data

total_entries.description: Total number of entries in the uncertainties dataset

total_benchmarks.description: Number of unique benchmark names in the dataset

categories.description: Statistics grouped by benchmark category. Category keys are derived from the ICSBEP benchmark naming convention: the first three hyphen-separated segments of the benchmark name form the category (e.g. benchmark 'heu-met-fast-001' belongs to category 'heu-met-fast').

count.description: Number of entries in this category

mean_keff.description: Arithmetic mean of k_eff values in this category

weighted_mean_keff.description: Inverse-variance-weighted mean of k_eff values (weight = 1/uncertainty^2). For entries with zero uncertainty, fall back to arithmetic mean.

chi_squared.description: Goodness-of-fit statistic against k_eff = 1.0: sum of ((keff - 1.0) / uncertainty)^2 over entries with nonzero uncertainty

reduced_chi_squared.description: Chi-squared divided by degrees of freedom (number of valid measurements minus one)

fissile_summary.description: Statistics grouped by fissile material type. Keys are the first segment of the benchmark name (e.g. 'heu', 'pu', 'leu', 'mix', 'ieu', 'u233').

count.description: Number of entries for this fissile material

outliers.description: Entries with anomalously large deviations of k_eff from unity. Only entries with nonzero uncertainty are candidates. Each reported outlier must have |deviation_sigma| > 3.0.

deviation_sigma.description: Signed deviation from unity in units of experimental uncertainty: (keff - 1.0) / uncertainty
